notes.title: Update Coming March 1st
notes.content:
An update is coming March 1st which will improve a few general items like font readability at scale. 

Most changes will be refactoring in the backend that you may not notice any changes from. 

Let me know if you think of anything you'd like to see changed!

notes.title: First Update of 2016: version 1.0.5 is Live!
notes.content:
Hi All,

  I just wanted to give you a rundown of what's in the new build real quick.

 - Improved resolution switching so that fullscreen works
 - Fixed issue with card collector achievement counting the wrong number
 - Fixed issue with crashing for some users on the final page
 - Minor tweaks to fonts and other small bug fixes

Let me know if you experience any issues at all!

Also just a reminder, please review the game if you have a minute: it is a huge help!

Thanks,

  Phil Royer
